description: Deterministic arithmetic for a prop firm account: risk per trade in USD, consecutive full-stop losses to breach max drawdown, a 25% buffer daily-loss guardrail, and the gain required to recover from a 50% drawdown. Maths only, not financial or trading advice.

account_size.description: Account balance in USD, for example 50000 or 100000.

drawdown_type.description: Drawdown calculation type: "static", "eod" (end-of-day) or "trailing" (intraday). Default: eod.

max_drawdown_usd.description: Maximum allowed drawdown in USD, for example 2000 or 10000.

risk_per_trade_pct.description: Percentage of account_size risked per trade, for example 0.5 or 1.

name: calculate_prop_risk
title: Calculate prop firm drawdown & risk maths
